2609.16532.title: Style-Debiased DPO: Updating LLM Knowledge with Factuality-Aware Synthetic Preference Data
2609.16532.paper_summary: Continued pretraining (CPT) with data augmentation such as paraphrasing can store inside a large language model (LLM) the knowledge of a small source corpus. The stored knowledge, however, is not always retrieved correctly. We study the eliciting side rather than the storing side: we use preference optimization, which learns from pairs of a preferred (chosen) and a dispreferred (rejected) response, so that the model elicits its stored knowledge more accurately. One proposed approach takes the model's own erroneous response as rejected and the gold answer as chosen, so as to suppress the error. When the target knowledge is partially known, however, most of these rejected responses are factually correct. Using direct preference optimization (DPO) then pushes down rejected responses that contain correct knowledge and differ from the chosen answer only in style, such as length and wording. We propose style-debiased DPO (SD-DPO), which scores whether the rejected response of each pair is factually correct, inverts the preference of such pairs, and weights them so that the learning signal due to differences in style cancels out as a whole. We first test whether, on top of EntiGraph, a representative storing-side method that runs CPT on text synthesized from the corpus, our method adds accuracy efficiently. On QuALITY, the reading-comprehension QA benchmark on which EntiGraph was evaluated, SD-DPO exceeds a baseline we CPT on EntiGraph's synthetic data from the same base model and evaluate with the same procedure. The training tokens this requires are a few dozen times fewer than the additional CPT needed for the same gain. For knowledge updating, the main goal of this work, we use AToKE, a knowledge-editing benchmark for facts that change over time. There, SD-DPO reaches an overall accuracy of 0.982 and answers with the new or the old fact according to the queried period.
2609.16532.paper_summary_zh: 持續預訓練 (CPT) 結合數據增強，例如意義重述，可以在大型語言模型 (LLM) 中儲存小型來源語料庫的知識。然而，儲存的知識並不總是能正確檢索。我們研究的是引出側面而非儲存側面：我們使用偏好優化，從一對偏好的（選擇的）和不偏好的（拒絕的）回應中學習，以便模型能更準確地引出其儲存的知識。一種提議的方法將模型自身的錯誤回應視為拒絕的，將正確答案視為選擇的，以抑制錯誤。然而，當目標知識部分已知時，大多數這些被拒絕的回應在事實上都是正確的。因此，使用直接偏好優化 (DPO) 會降低包含正確知識且僅在風格上（如長度和措辭）與選擇的答案不同的拒絕回應。我們提出了風格去偏見的 DPO (SD-DPO)，它評分每對拒絕回應是否在事實上正確，反轉這些對的偏好，並加權它們，以便由於風格差異所產生的學習信號整體上相互抵消。我們首先測試在 EntiGraph 上，這是一種代表性的儲存側方法，對從語料庫合成的文本運行 CPT，我們的方法是否能有效提高準確性。在 QuALITY 上，這是對 EntiGraph 進行評估的閱讀理解 QA 基準，SD-DPO 超過了我們在 EntiGraph 的合成數據上進行 CPT 的基線，並使用相同的程序進行評估。這所需的訓練標記數量比為獲得相同增益所需的額外 CPT 少幾十倍。對於知識更新，本工作的主要目標，我們使用 AToKE，這是一個隨時間變化的事實的知識編輯基準。在那裡，SD-DPO 達到了 0.982 的整體準確率，根據查詢的時間段回答新事實或舊事實。
2609.16532.author: Takayuki Yamamoto et.al.
